successCriteria.description: The Employee interface is defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` with all canonical fields (id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt) and imports EmploymentStatus from `src/shared/types`.

The IEmployeeRepository interface is defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts` with all six methods: findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findAll, create, update, softDelete — each with the exact signatures specified in the phase scope.

EmployeeRepository implements IEmployeeRepository using Knex wired to the shared pg Pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, and all queries use Knex's parameterized query builder (no raw string interpolation).
`create()` accepts an Employee without id/createdAt/updatedAt/deletedAt, persists a row in the employees table, and returns the full Employee with generated id and timestamps.
`softDelete(id)` sets deletedAt to the current timestamp on the matching row and does not physically remove the row.
`update(id, data)` applies only the provided partial fields to the matching row, sets updatedAt to the current timestamp, and returns the updated Employee or null if not found.
`src/modules/employee/index.ts` barrel-exports the Employee interface, IEmployeeRepository interface, and EmployeeRepository class.

Jest unit tests at `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts` cover all six repository methods with a mocked Knex instance, verifying correct query construction, parameter passing, and return values.

constraints: The repository must use Knex's query builder for all database operations — no raw SQL strings, no string interpolation for values. Knex parameterizes by default.
